summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #39. Added: (1) parity corpus fixture (byte-identical copy of viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json, sha256 7b7b4d90..., 12 scenarios, algorithm_version 1) plus SolverParityCorpusTests replaying it through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer and the CompositionSolver fast path; (2) PaletteAPIClientTests additions pinning the /api/v1 wire contract (versioned URLs, Accept header, envelope decoding, 401/5xx/undecodable error mapping, testConnection) as the migration safety net; (3) GeneratedClientAdoptionTests red-phase structural sentinels (Package.swift must declare swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime; an OpenAPI document snapshot must be committed) which fail until the implementation run lands; (4) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md documenting corpus location and refresh. LIMITATION: no Swift toolchain exists in this container (command -v swift fails), so swift test could not be executed; bin/lint passes (its no-toolchain path skips build/tests by design). Parity replay logic was cross-validated instead with an independent Python reimplementation of the corpus semantics: all 12 scenarios match the corpus exactly (scores bit-exact, exclusions, earliest-wins ties incl. 3-way and duplicate-vector ties, unknown/zero weight handling, null selection for missing-target/all-excluded). README section could not be added: README.md is outside the test-writing-phase commit allowlist; content staged in docs/solver-parity-corpus.md for the implementation run to surface.
